name: Claude Analysis Sandbox (YOLO Mode)
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y poppler-utils && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && mkdir -p .claude && echo '{"defaultMode": "bypassPermissions"}' > .claude/settings.local.json && echo 'alias claude="claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"' >> ~/.bashrc
